settings.eyebrow: 60 minutes. One locked room. Your wits.
settings.headline:
The clock is ticking.
Can you escape?
settings.copy: The Red Door is a cinematic escape room experience with three fully themed rooms, live puzzles, and immersive storylines. Gather your team and see if you've got what it takes.

settings.title: Three doors.
settings.intro: Each room is a fully themed, story-driven puzzle world. Pick your difficulty and step inside.

design.title: The Alchemist's Vault
design.text: Beginner-friendly. A Victorian alchemist vanished, and his vault holds the secret. Solve the symbols and unlock it before time runs out.

design.title: The Drowned Submarine
design.text: Medium. Floodwaters are rising on a sunken sub. Fix the systems, decode the coordinates, and surface — or be sealed in forever.

design.title: The Midnight Carnival
design.text: Hard. A cursed carnival that only appears after dark. Break the ringmaster's spell and find your way out before the lights go out.

build.title: 60 minutes
build.text: Every room gives you exactly one hour. Watch the clock, work as a team, and don't waste a second.

build.title: Live hints
build.text: Stuck? Our game master drops subtle clues through the room's intercom to keep you moving.

build.title: 2–8 players
build.text: Rooms fit small teams to bigger groups. Bring friends, family, or your whole office.

launch.title: Escape & win
launch.text: Escape in time and your team earns a spot on our wall of fame — plus bragging rights for the week.

settings.title: Your escape, step by step

steps.title: Pick your room
steps.text: Choose a theme and difficulty that fits your group. Not sure? Our team will recommend one.

steps.title: Book your time
steps.text: Reserve a slot online or call ahead. Rooms run every hour, seven days a week.

steps.title: Hear the briefing
steps.text: Our game master explains the story and the rules. Then the door locks and the clock starts.

steps.title: Solve the puzzles
steps.text: Work together to find clues, crack codes, and unlock the way out. Hint button available if you need it.

steps.title: Escape (or not!)
steps.text: Make it out and celebrate. If the clock wins, you'll still want to come back and conquer it next time.

settings.note: No prior experience needed — every room has a learning curve and live hints to keep you in the game.

settings.title: Book before this week's slots
settings.expired_text: This week's slots are full — book ahead for next weekend.

settings.title: What escaping teams
settings.intro: Real words from players who made it out — and a few who didn't.

reviews.quote: The Drowned Submarine had us on edge the whole hour. Great puzzles, fair hints, and we escaped with four minutes to spare!
reviews.author: Nate W.

reviews.quote: We've done a lot of escape rooms and this is easily the most immersive. The set design alone is worth it.
reviews.author: Priya S.

reviews.quote: Took my whole team as a teambuilder. Great communication, tough puzzles, and everyone got to contribute. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Marcus B.

settings.title: Questions, answered
settings.intro: Everything you need to know before you lock the door behind you.

items.question: What if we can't escape in time?
items.answer: No one is trapped! The game master lets you out at the end of your hour. About 38% of teams escape — the rest leave with a story and a reason to come back.

items.question: What's the minimum age?
items.answer: Most rooms are best for ages 12 and up, though younger kids can join family-friendly rooms with an adult. Contact us if you're unsure.

items.question: Can we book a private session?
items.answer: Yes. You can book an entire room for just your group at any time. Corporate events and birthdays are our specialties.

items.question: Is it safe?
items.answer: Absolutely. Rooms are fully monitored, exits are never truly locked, and our game masters are trained to intervene if anyone needs to leave early.

settings.title: Your time starts now
settings.intro: Reserve a slot online or reach out with questions. Groups of 10+ get a dedicated booking line.

settings.blurb: Cinematic escape rooms where your team's wits are the only way out. 60 minutes. One door. Can you escape?
